esptool-js 0.4.3 (vendored, unmodified)
=======================================

Files
  esptool.js     Copy of esptool-js@0.4.3 `bundle.js` (the package's own pre-built, self-contained
                 ES module: ESPLoader, Transport, reset helpers, all chip stub flashers inlined).
                 Exports: ESPLoader, ROM, Transport, classicReset, customReset, hardReset,
                 usbJTAGSerialReset, validateCustomResetStringSequence.
  LICENSE        Apache License 2.0 (esptool-js).
  LICENSE-pako   MIT license of pako 2.1.0, which is bundled inside esptool.js.

Source
  https://github.com/espressif/esptool-js  (npm: esptool-js@0.4.3)
  Same version the standalone HOJA baseband updater uses (hoja_esptool/package-lock.json,
  deployed at handheldlegend.github.io/hoja_baseband/).

Used by
  src/sections/wireless/esp-flasher.js — flashes the ESP32 wireless module ("baseband") over
  Web Serial or the WebUSB CH34x driver in src/sections/wireless/ch34x-webusb.js. Loaded lazily
  with a dynamic import only when an update actually starts.

Attributions
  esptool-js — Copyright Espressif Systems (Shanghai) Co. Ltd. — Apache License 2.0
  pako       — Copyright (C) 2014-2017 Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn — MIT AND Zlib

               and Mark Adler, under the zlib license reproduced below)
